"(ঘ) "কাঁচামাল" অর্থ বিভিন্ন ধাতুর Flat-rolled products, rod, bars and wires, tube, pipe, hollow profile অথবা সমজাতীয় কোন পদার্থ।"

Customs Act 1969: The Government exercises its authority under section 19(1) of this Act to amend existing customs notifications.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: This Act provides the legal basis under section 14(1) for the Government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to amend tax-related notifications in the public interest.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the designated authority that must be consulted by the Government before issuing or amending customs and tax-related notifications.
TABLE-I: This table is amended to insert new H.S. Code entries for goods such as mold release preparations, adhesives, organic composite solvents, polyamides, and synthetic rubbers, while certain existing entries are removed.
TABLE-II: This table is amended to insert new entries for angles, shapes, and sections, and to replace existing H.S. Code descriptions for tubes, pipes, locks, starters, and speedometers.
Raw Material: This term is defined to include various metallic flat-rolled products, rods, bars, wires, tubes, pipes, hollow profiles, or similar materials for the purpose of the relevant regulations.
